tar.scope: Signed source and native preparation; Rust translation and original validation are separate. SELinux disabled; ACL/xattr support retained.

sharutils.scope: Two signed GNU Sharutils source entries translated with command-private AutoOpts/Gnulib helpers; compilation and runtime validation are separate.

cpio.scope: Signed upstream source baseline. Translation, compilation, and runtime validation are recorded separately.

gawk.scope: Signed original source baseline. Translation, compilation, and runtime validation remain separate.

bash.scope: Signed original source baseline. Translation, compilation, and runtime validation remain separate.

binutils.scope: Signed source baseline. Entry translation, compilation, and runtime validation remain separate.

inetutils.scope: Signed source baseline. Entry translation, compilation, and runtime validation remain separate.

patch.scope: Signed source baseline. Entry translation, compilation, and runtime validation remain separate.

less.scope: Verified fixed GNU release source baseline; pinning alone is not a translated or tested command.

screen.scope: Verified fixed GNU release source baseline; pinning alone is not a translated or tested command.

wget.scope: Verified fixed GNU release source baseline; pinning alone is not a translated or tested command.
